title: 四番旅館 The 4th Ryokan
description:
Feeling overworked, you’ve decided to take vacation and spend 3 nights at “The 4th Ryokan,” a remote ryokan in the mountains. 

You’ll be staying in a luxurious Japanese style room that overlooks a beautiful courtyard.

If there are no anomalies, you should go to bed; whereas if there is an anomaly, you should call the reception in order to progress to the next day. 

“The 4th Ryokan”is a short, first-person game with a bit of horror that should take around 60 to 90 minutes to complete.

The game controls are simple. To play, navigate the room by walking (mouse movement with WASD keys,) selecting options (left click,) and zooming in (right click.)

It’s a walking simulator game inspired by The Exit 8 where players navigate a closed room, searching for anomalies to continue to the end of the ryokan stay.

There is no restriction on streaming the gameplay and/or uploading play-through videos; however, the creators assume all risks.
description_short: You are spending 3 nights at a ryokan overlooking a courtyard. If there are no anomalies, you should go to bed; whereas if there is an anomaly, you should call the reception in order to progress to the next day.
